mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, task_id, id AS item_id, creator_account_id, current_step, dispatch_stage, dispatch_status FROM normal_group_creation_item WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND dispatch_status = 'PENDING' AND next_dispatch_at <= #{now} AND dispatch_stage IN ('PREPARE', 'CREATE', 'POST_PROCESS') ORDER BY next_dispatch_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenant_id, task_id, id AS item_id, creator_account_id, current_step, dispatch_stage, dispatch_status FROM normal_group_creation_item WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND dispatch_status = 'PROCESSING' AND processing_started_at IS NOT NULL AND processing_started_at <= #{processingBefore} AND current_step IN ('PREPARING_CONTACTS', 'CREATING_GROUP', 'POST_PROCESSING') ORDER BY processing_started_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
